source.title: Call for Applicants - WCAT Leader (September 2018)
source.content:
The successful passing of the [WCA Competition Announcement Policy Version 2.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Competition%20Announcement.pdf) established the WCA Competition Announcement Team that is in need of a leader. The **WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT)** is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for approving and announcing WCA Competitions.

The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered. Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:
     1. Strong leadership skills
     2. Attention to detail
     3. Good knowledge of Regulations and policies
     4. Excellent communication skills

Due to the time-sensitive nature of this work, the Leader of this committee must be very responsive to email, mostly within 24 hours. The WCAT will need to process approximately 40 requests per week, which generates 150-200 emails. 
<!-- break -->
The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **September 24th, 2018, 23:59 UTC** privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)). 

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:
     - Brief personal introduction.
     - Summary of activities done for the WCA.
     - Ambitions as the WCAT Leader.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WCAT can be found in the [WCA Competition Announcement Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Competition%20Announcement.pdf).

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2017.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 比赛公示组负责人招募（2018 年 9 月）
translation.content:
[WCA 比赛公示政策 2.0 版](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Competition%20Announcement.pdf)获通过后，WCA 比赛公示组正式成立，目前需要一位负责人。**WCA 比赛公示组（WCAT）**是 WCA 的咨询委员会，负责批准和公示 WCA 比赛。

申请向所有人开放，不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 8 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

1. 出色的领导能力。
2. 注重细节。
3. 熟悉竞赛规则及政策。
4. 出色的沟通能力。

由于这项工作有较强的时效要求，负责人须及时回复邮件，通常应在 24 小时内回复。WCAT 每周约需处理 40 项申请，相关邮件约为 150 至 200 封。

申请现已开放，请于 **2018 年 9 月 24 日 23:59 UTC 前**，将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
- 担任 WCAT 负责人后的工作设想。

申请者还须提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WCAT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 比赛公示政策](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Competition%20Announcement.pdf)。

申请截止后的下一周，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 动议 10.2017.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节的规定投票选定人选，经高级代表及现任委员会／团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
